data.name: RLG:Origins
data.detailed_description:
No dialogue options. Your words are the choice.

Beneath a land governed by starlight lies Asteria, the Labyrinth of Oaths.

An oath once sworn to save someone still endures long after the expedition ended, forcing people into roles within a promise that refuses to die.

Choose one of three companions and approach the sealed Fourth Door. You will not advance by clicking through a list of dialogue options.

“Swing a sword. Cast a spell. Use an ability all your own.”

“Pet a cat. Cook a meal. Throw a pickle.”

Your own words become investigation, negotiation, combat, and—eventually—an intervention in the oath itself.

The world will not rewrite itself to please you

AI takes on the roles of GM and characters. The world’s facts, the nature of its enemies, the terms of its oaths, and the consequences of your actions remain governed by fixed rules.

Persuasion cannot make everything possible. A key that never existed will not appear. Evidence you failed to preserve may be lost. Every person you meet has motives they will not abandon just because you asked nicely.

Freedom of action means responsibility for what follows.

Choose one companion. Enter as two.

Each companion carries different knowledge, fears, and secrets. Your choice changes which evidence you can uncover, which words can reach another person, and which answers remain possible when the labyrinth turns hostile.

You cannot bring everyone. A truth hidden on this expedition may reveal itself differently on the next.

A demanding labyrinth expedition

Asteria is not kind to the inattentive. Defeating an enemy is not always enough, and naming the truth is not the same as proving it. You will need to observe, form hypotheses, question your companion’s words, and sometimes create a path without fighting.

Many expeditions will end in tragedy. Even so, careful observation and inventive thinking can open a way forward.

No single golden answer.

The ending is not decided by one final prompt. What you learned, whom you trusted, what you prepared, and which responsibilities you accepted all shape what becomes of the oath.

No ending saves everything.

The path you took becomes a story that belongs only to you and your companion.

Video and Livestreaming Policy

You are welcome to upload videos and host livestreams featuring RLG: Origins. No prior notice or permission is required.

Both individuals and organizations may use the official monetization features provided by video and streaming platforms.

Where practical, please include the game title, RLG: Origins, and a link to its Steam store page. If your content includes major story spoilers, we also appreciate a spoiler warning for your audience.

Please do not:

  • Redistribute game files or extracted assets

  • Present your content as officially produced, sponsored, or endorsed by the developer

  • Use the game in content that violates applicable laws or the rights of others

data.short_description: Act in your own words to uncover the truth behind a broken oath. In this challenging high-fantasy Role Living Game, AI plays the GM and every character while fixed rules determine success and failure. Choose one companion, then investigate, negotiate, and fight your way to the story's end.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 or DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. CPU-only operation is supported, but AI responses may take longer. No internet connection is required after installation.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible dedicated GPU with 8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. 32 GB RAM is recommended for CPU-only operation.

content_descriptors.notes: RLG:Origins contains stylized fantasy combat, non-graphic depictions of injury and death, skeletal remains, dark horror themes, psychological distress, and occasional unsettling dialogue. Violence is presented without realistic blood, dismemberment, or gore. The game contains no sexual content or sexual violence, and no depictions of suicide or self-harm.
